instruction: Export your notes to HTML in Apple Notes, using the default export path.

parameters.note_body: Track kickoff timeline, required documents, and communication templates.

reference_command:
default_export="$HOME/Desktop/notes"
target="$HOME/Desktop/notes_export_2"
if [ -d "$target" ]; then
  rm -rf "$target"
fi
printf 'y\n\n' | memo notes --export
if [ -d "$default_export" ]; then
  mv "$default_export" "$target"
fi
